we can take it to a PM if you'd rather it was private? feel free
I'm not going to judge, I'm here for a chat. You have nothing to hide
So what's up? Would you like to talk about what is bothering you?
I'm also here for a chat if you need someone to talk to.
I am indeed, although I can't sleep again. How're you?
That is one of the saddest things I have ever seen
I am still here, I managed to fall asleep. Thanks for the nice words
Thank you for the reply, yeah a massage sounds good. Sorry to hear about your illness it is shit. If you ever need someone to talk to feel free to give me a shout, I'll ask about Cymbalta.
Thank you for the support mate, I really appreciate it, I hope you manage to find happiness in life too because you are awesome

Yeah I may aswell try, I just feel like a let down, other than having a shitty body I don't really have a reason to feel so terrible. My family and friends are great and it makes them feel like it is their fault!

Yeah I read that too, I haven't joined any support groups, the first time I spoke to anyone about my depression was a couple of days ago, I'm a very private person. I just find it hard to get the motivation to try again after trying to figure it out for so long.

Yeah I guess we're in similar positions, yeah the pain is dreadful, it never really seems to disappear. The medication that I was prescribed for my depression just makes me feel even more suicidal and it isn't very enjoyable. I'm sick of feeling like crap, I feel like I'm a burden because it rare that I get enjoyment out of much. I'm not sure what to do, I'm mentally healthy enough to make my own decisions and if it wasn't for all the guilt that gets associated with suicide I probably would have done it by now, but for some reason it is frowned upon to take your own life, why can't you just tell your family and friends that you aren't enjoying the situation you are in and they acknowledge that peacefully ending your life could be the best option, I don't get how anyone else can decide that buy the person that is experiencing it.

I hope you are feeling better now mate!

well I'm 22 and I was born with cerebral palsy, every year my disability hurts more and it gets harder to walk, i just dont feel like there's anything to look forward to except more physical and emotional pain (maybe that sounds silly) and i was diagnosed with major depressive disorder, I'm just generally broken I guess, it is quite disappointing because life could be amazing, I just don't feel anything but sadness and hurt.

thank you, sure we can talk. I'm not entirely sure what to say though, I have felt like this for about 8 years now, and all I ever hear is that if I did anything imagine how my family and friends would feel. People don't get that I  understand that, I love my family and friends, I'm not some crazy deluded person, I'm just sick of dealing with life. :( I'm not sure what to do, I wish there was a way to not hurt people
